# DelayAwareSpikeEventDelivery

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A framework that schedules spike event delivery in SNNs based on synaptic delay constraints to ensure temporal precision. Enables accurate temporal computation in neuromorphic systems, critical for event-driven processing in iNEST.
